snippet.title: Yume Nikki Fangame playthrough - Yume Nisshi ver. 0.05
snippet.description:
Content warning:
-Blood and gore
-Violence
-Body horror
-Eye trauma
-The Match effect has a bit of a strobe light to it

Read more about this fangame: https://ynfg.yume.wiki/Yume_Nisshi_(%E5%A4%A2%E6%97%A5%E8%AA%8C)_
Download: https://ux.getuploader.com/yumenisshi01/download/12 (Password: yumenisshi)
Join The NEX Room Discord Server! - https://discord.gg/ScENyan

Timestamps:
0:00 Starting the game, Getting Scrapbook ITEM
3:18 Getting Match EFFECT 
4:12 Getting Rabbit EFFECT, Unlocking Red Sea Nexus Door
9:30 Getting Scarf EFFECT
10:50 Getting Nail Bat EFFECT, Exploring the School and Hospital, Getting Curtain EFFECT, Unlocking Mirror World Nexus Door
19:28 Getting Eyeball Box EFFECT
21:56 Getting Porcelain Doll EFFECT, Unlocking Neon World Nexus Door, Getting Sack EFFECT
26:30 Getting Straw Hat EFFECT, Unlocking Mural World Nexus Door, Getting Flower Crown EFFECT, Exploring the Hell Maze
37:28 Checking out menu types, Getting Cage EFFECT
40:29 Getting Horns EFFECT, Getting Dove ITEM
47:24 Getting Braids and Snow Bug EFFECTS, Visiting the Faceless Couple, Getting Kaleidoscope EFFECT
1:00:07 Exploring Bird's Eye View Park, Getting Chimera EFFECT, Getting Bottled EFFECT
1:12:51 Getting Thorns EFFECT
1:15:24 Getting Ocarina EFFECT, Seeing Yolk EVENT
1:23:09 Getting Pliant EFFECT
1:28:17 Getting Older Sister EFFECT
1:32:54 Getting Proto EFFECT, Seeing Murder House EVENT
1:38:02 Checking real world effect meanings
1:40:01 Getting Chocolate ITEM
1:42:06 Exploring Trish's House, Seeing Corpse Blitz EVENT
1:52:23 Exploring Needle World
1:56:15 Seeing the Flying EVENT
1:59:08 Visiting the Giraffe at the Skyscraper, Trying on various effects in GB World

A few notes:
- I made at least three jumpcuts to get rid of unnecessary wandering and getting lost/random event triggering, to save time for your enjoyment.
- To get the Proto effect, you must have visited the fangames reference room at least once beforehand.
- I found out you can turn on the radio to the first channel to make butterflies guide the way to the Rabbit effect while in the Rose Garden. Very useful!
